candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` so the caller's imBalances is never credited after supplying.
Replace `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` with `imBalances[to] = creditsIssued;` so a second deposit by/to the same address overwrites instead of accumulating.
Replace `imBalances[to] += creditsIssued;` with `imBalances[msg.sender] += creditsIssued;` so the credits are credited to the caller instead of the designated beneficiary `to`.
